mechanism: Strict two-candle rule: prior candle direction opposite to current; current opens at/beyond prior close and closes beyond prior extreme (bullish: open<=prior close and close>prior high; bearish mirror). Flags only body-dominance displacement as a decisive order-flow shift rather than generic engulfing.
data_needed: OHLC series for consecutive bars; chart PeriodSeconds.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any Symbol/_Period (live chart pattern + retest demos; no fixed pair required)
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a deterministic, codeable body-dominance change event that is stricter than ordinary engulfing—usable as an impulse/shift sensor before zone logic.
quote: It focuses on decisive price displacement where the current candle fully consumes the prior candle's range, signaling a clear shift in order flow.

mechanism: SEARCH→FOUND state machine: on perfect engulf, store prior bar H/L as zone and set retest deadline = now + barsRetestRange×PeriodSeconds; invalidate if close breaks zone; confirm retest if price wicks into zone extremes and closes back with lower/upper wick ratio ≥ wickThreshold (% of candle range); then draw zone and reset.
data_needed: OHLC+time; barsRetestRange; wickThreshold; zone high/low from engulfed bar.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any Symbol/_Period; barsRetestRange default 10; wickThreshold default 35%
why_new_for_mis: Turns a one-bar pattern into a timed pullback-validation sensor with wick-strength quality and hard invalidation—MIS can emit confirmed zone-reclaim events, not just arrows.
quote: a state‑driven retest validator that creates a monitoring zone, enforces invalidation, limits validation to a configurable bar window (barsRetestRange), and confirms retests using a wick‑ratio filter (wickThreshold).

mechanism: OnInit over [startDate,endDate]: detect perfect engulf+retest setups; entry at open of bar after retest; scan maxLookahead bars for MFE/MAE in points; group setups by retestBars; score = avgMFE−avgMAE; constrained brute-force r=1..barsRetestRange picks optimalBullishRetestRange and optimalBearishRetestRange separately; OnCalculate uses those windows.
data_needed: CopyRates window; barsRetestRange search horizon; maxLookahead; wickThreshold; MqlRates series.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD observation with defaults; two FX pairs in final init test; per-symbol/per-_Period optimization
why_new_for_mis: Data-driven, symbol/TF-specific timing sensor for how long a pullback window should stay open—MIS can adapt confirmation horizons to local volatility/rhythm instead of a fixed bar count.
quote: we evaluate historical setups using MFE (Maximum Favorable Excursion) and MAE (Maximum Adverse Excursion) measured from a consistent entry rule, score candidate retest distances (avgMFE − avgMAE) with a constrained brute-force search over a single parameter

mechanism: CSwingEngine scans swing_tf (default H4) with strength N on each side; labels HH/LH/HL/LL vs prior same-type swing; ClassifyTrend: last high HH + last low HL → TREND_UP; LH+LL → TREND_DOWN; mixed/insufficient → TREND_RANGE. Update gated on new HTF bar; draws on any LTF chart via datetime anchors.
data_needed: CopyHigh/Low/Time on swing_tf; strength; lookback; optional ATR on swing_tf for label offset.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 chart / H4 swings; Gold M15 / H4; GBPUSD H1 / D1; strength=3 lookback=150–200
why_new_for_mis: Separates structure regime (HTF swing labels) from entry TF noise—MIS gets a stable up/down/range context sensor that only refreshes on HTF closes.
quote: An uptrend is confirmed when the most recently labeled swing high is HH and the most recently labeled swing low is HL.

mechanism: DetectRange with prior down/up trend bias → accumulation/distribution; Spring/Upthrust = penetrate S/R by tolerance then recover same bar on tick vol < avg×LowVolMult; SOS/SOW = close through R/S on vol > avg×HighVolMult; LPS/LPSY = low-vol pullback to broken level within LPSBars. Sequence enforced; invalidation resets IDLE.

why_new_for_mis: Volume-qualified sequential phase machine for accum/distrib transitions—MIS can sense spring→SOS→LPS (or UT→SOW→LPSY) regime change with liquidity confirmation, not isolated candle checks.
quote: A standalone check for any one of these events, regardless of what preceded it, will produce many false signals. The finite state machine enforces the correct sequence

mechanism: box_size = 0.25×range_ATR (floor 3 pips); BuildPFChart snaps OHLC oscillations in range to X/O columns with InpPFReversalBoxes; CountColumnsAtLevel at LPS/LPSY count_line; Target = count_line ± (h_count×box_size×reversal); reject if target pips outside [Min,Max] else fallback 2R.
data_needed: Range support/resistance/start_bar; range_atr; count_line at LPS/LPSY close; reversal boxes.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4 example (18 cols → 90 pips worked example); H4+ recommended
why_new_for_mis: Converts consolidation width into a volatility-scaled horizontal 'cause' magnitude and projected effect price—MIS can sense how large a post-range move is implied by structure, not a fixed R-multiple.
quote: Target = (Column Count × Box Size × Reversal Factor) + Count Line Price

mechanism: On quote-only FX, volume/dollar AFML bars collapse to tick (CV≈0); keep four families—time, tick, tick-imbalance, tick-runs—calibrated to ~same bar count (~H1 cadence). Mid-price tick rule; measure lag-1 autocorr and excess kurtosis: tick/tick-runs cut time-bar kurtosis ~14→~5.3.
data_needed: Bid/ask tick stream (mid); bar_size / target_timeframe calibration; no true volume required.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD 60.5M quote ticks 2022–2023; families matched to ~12k bars / H1-like cadence
why_new_for_mis: Operational map of which alternative clocks remain distinct on spot FX and how they condition returns—MIS can choose sampling representations knowing volume/dollar labels are fake on quote feeds.
quote: The ten AFML bar types therefore collapse to four genuinely distinct families on spot-FX quote data: time, tick, tick-imbalance, and tick-runs.

mechanism: For each triple-barrier event, uniqueness per bar = 1/concurrent_events; sample uniqueness = mean over lifespan; cell avg uniqueness sets RandomForest max_samples (AFML §4.5/6.3) with balanced_subsample. Observed: RSI/Bollinger ~0.61–0.66; stateful ADX/DI ~0.37–0.38. Score meta AUC under PurgedKFold.
data_needed: Event t1 index aligned to close; get_av_uniqueness_from_triple_barrier; primary side + features.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD 2022–2023 across four bar families × RSI/Bollinger/ADX-DI
why_new_for_mis: Average uniqueness is itself a sensing feature of how concurrent/overlapping labeled horizons are—MIS can use it to gauge label dependence and to size bootstrap draws for sequence meta-models.
quote: Setting the forest's max_samples to average uniqueness makes each tree draw only the effective (non-redundant) number of rows instead of the full N.
